For connection problems, include both operating systems and app versions, transport (USB / Bluetooth / LAN), terminal type, and steps to reproduce. For Mac, include the chip architecture. For iOS, state whether you use a simulator or physical device, your signing method, and whether the app is in the foreground. Remove pairing details and private terminal content from screenshots and logs. Report security vulnerabilities privately through [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

连接问题请提供两端系统与应用版本、Mac 芯片类型、USB / 蓝牙 / LAN、终端类型和复现步骤。iOS 问题请注明模拟器或真机、自行签名方式，以及应用是否在前台。配对信息和私人终端内容应先遮盖。安全漏洞请按 [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) 私下报告。
